category.title: Experience type
category.description: Primary optional filter on Experience__c.Type__c. Use an exact type: Adventure Activities; Beaches & Snorkeling; Cultural Tours & Workshops; Dining Experiences; Family & Kids' Activities; Fitness & Exercise; Golf; Nature & Eco Tours; Nightlife & Entertainment; Relaxation & Quiet Zones; Spa & Wellness; Swimming Pools; Tennis & Pickleball; Water Sports. Map adventure to Adventure Activities and golf to Golf. Leave searchPhrase unset for type browsing.

searchPhrase.title: Experience name (optional)
searchPhrase.description: Optional literal experience-name substring, only when a name or specific activity is requested. Do not put a type such as adventure or golf here when browsing by type. Omit for type browsing.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Optional first date in America/Chicago; defaults to today.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Optional last date, at most 30 days after the first date.

guestCount.title: Guest count
guestCount.description: Optional integer from 1 to 100; defaults to 1.
